title: GNK ASG S+Chat — existing Intelligence Desk API public use case

aiGovernance.purpose: Public general-question and portal-related AI chat via existing rate-limited Intelligence Desk API; informational assistance only

disclosure.text: Razgovarate s umjetnom inteligencijom. Odgovori mogu biti netočni.

technicalControls.rateLimit: Existing Intelligence Desk server-side KV hourly limiter, contingent on configured KV binding
technicalControls.localStorage: sessionStorage per browser tab, last 16 entries; never claim remote server has no logs
technicalControls.backendRequired: GNK ASG direct-operator worker with configured OPENAI_API_KEY and KV binding, not independently verified live
technicalControls.security: No arbitrary tool access, no client-supplied system prompt, no claimed actions or outbound mail

risksAndRelease: Check prod HTTP GET /s-chat/, JS and CSS
Perform authorized safe test POST (no personal data) and inspect 200/429/503 status
Verify data processing/retention and abuse mitigation
No independent substantive human review of responses claimed
notes: This is internal initial product-risk documentation based on code inspection, not legal approval or verification of Cloudflare/OpenAI retention settings.
